query:
SELECT user_id,
      CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM birth_date) > 1 THEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)::SMALLINT - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM birth_date)::SMALLINT END AS age
      FROM birthdays WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM birth_date) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE)
      AND (EXTRACT(DAY FROM birth_date) = EXTRACT(DAY FROM CURRENT_DATE) OR (
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM birth_date) = 2 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM birth_date) = 29 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) = 2 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM CURRENT_DATE) = 28
        AND NOT (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)::INT % 4 = 0 AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)::INT % 100 != 0 OR EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)::INT % 400 = 0))
      ))
